cancel.title: Cancel this voucher?
cancel.body_one: The {{count}} item goes back into stock. The record stays in the register, marked Cancelled.
cancel.body_other: The {{count}} items go back into stock. The record stays in the register, marked Cancelled.
cancel.bodyCredit_one: The {{count}} item goes back into stock and the amount is removed from the party balance. The record stays in the register, marked Cancelled.
cancel.bodyCredit_other: The {{count}} items go back into stock and the amount is removed from the party balance. The record stays in the register, marked Cancelled.
cancel.filedWarn: This bill is from an earlier month. If that month's GST is already filed, do not cancel it: make a return (credit note) instead, so this month's return shows it.
cancel.paidQuestion: {{amount}} was paid when this bill was made. What happens to it?
cancel.paidBack: I gave it back to the customer
cancel.paidKeep: Keep it as an advance for {{party}} (their balance goes down)

toast.cancelledNoEdit: Cancelled vouchers cannot be edited. Duplicate it instead.
toast.cancelledOffline: Cancelled {{number}} on this device. Stock restored. It will be sent when you are back online.

returns.title: Return items: {{number}}
returns.intro: Bill to {{party}} on {{date}} for {{amount}}. Type how many of each came back.
returns.nothingLeft: Everything on this bill has already come back.

settleHint.ADJUST: Taken off what the party owes. If it is more than they owe, it stays as an advance.
settleHint.CASH: You give the money back in cash. The party's balance does not change.
settleHint.UPI: You send the money back on UPI. The party's balance does not change.
settleHint.BANK: You send the money back to their bank. The party's balance does not change.

returns.pick: Type a quantity for the items that came back.
returns.none: No returns on this bill yet.
returns.cancelBody: The goods go back out of stock. The {{amount}} you paid back is not taken back automatically.
returns.cancelBodyAdjust: The goods go back out of stock and {{amount}} goes back on the party's balance.
returns.savedOffline: Return of {{amount}} saved on this device. It gets its number when you are back online.
returns.waitingNote: Saved on this device. The credit note number is given when it reaches the server; print after that for the final copy.
returns.creditRefundWarn: This bill is on credit. Paying money back leaves the whole bill on their balance, so they would get money back and still owe it. Usually choose Off the balance.
